articles.title: JEP 543 Finalizes Structured Concurrency in JDK 28, Ending Seven Preview Rounds
articles.summary:
JEP 543, Structured Concurrency, has been integrated into JDK 28, bringing the StructuredTaskScope API in java.util.concurrent to final status with no API changes from JDK 27's seventh preview. For codebases already on JDK 27, the migration comes down to recompiling without --enable-preview.
Finalization concludes the longest preview cycle of any Project Loom feature. Structured concurrency debuted as an incubator API in JEP 428 (JDK 19) and JEP 437 (JDK 20), then progressed through seven previews: JEP 453 (JDK 21), JEP 462 (JDK 22), JEP 480 (JDK 23), JEP 499 (JDK 24), JEP 505 (JDK 25), JEP 525 (JDK 26), and JEP 533 (JDK 27). Across every iteration, the core objective has been to treat groups of related subtasks running in different threads as a single unit of work, ensuring that a failure in one subtask cancels the others and that the parent scope cannot exit before all child threads have terminated. Traditional ExecutorService and Future pipelines do not enforce those boundaries: a parent method can return while subtasks continue running in the background, and a subtask failure surfaces only when a caller eventually invokes Future.get().
The API centers on StructuredTaskScope<T, R, R_X extends Throwable>, a sealed interface opened through static factory methods rather than public constructors. The zero-argument open() factory returns a scope whose join() method waits for all subtasks to succeed, cancels the rest on the first failure, and throws ExecutionException:

Cette découverte, annoncée par l’université de Warwick en Angleterre le 15 octobre 2026, est détaillée dans la revue RAS Techniques and Instruments. Les scientifiques ont étudié les naines blanches, des vestiges très denses laissés par des étoiles en fin de vie (c’est ce que deviendra le Soleil après sa mort). Or, selon ces chercheurs, certaines naines blanches peuvent briller dans une large gamme de couleurs, y compris en vert.
Pourquoi les étoiles n’ont pas toutes la même couleur
Pour les astronomes, la couleur d’une étoile renseigne d’abord sur sa température de surface. articles.title: La "ameba de fuego" rompe el récord de calor para la vida compleja y obliga a replantear dónde buscar vida extraterrestre
articles.summary:
A la hora de buscar vida extraterrestre, tenemos muy en cuenta la temperatura del planeta o satélite en cuestión. Generalmente se necesita que estén a una distancia adecuada de su estrella. Ni demasiado lejos, ya que haría frío, ni tampoco tan cerca como para que la temperatura sea abrasadora. La zona de habitabilidad suele ser esa en la que la temperatura podría mantener el agua líquida, ni helada ni en forma de gas. Sin embargo, si lo que queremos es encontrar organismos eucariotas, se tiende a afinar más, ya que suelen llevarse muy mal con el calor.
El récord estaba en 60ºC, pero ahora un equipo de científicos de la Universidad de Siracusa ha descubierto una ameba capaz de reproducirse a 63ºC e incluso de recuperar su actividad después de los 70ºC. Puede parecer una diferencia mínima, pero cambia bastante las reglas del juego.
Ameba de fuego. La ameba en cuestión fue hallada en pozas de agua caliente del Parque Nacional Volcánico Lassen (California). Resistía tan bien el calor que fue bautizada como Incendiamoeba cascadensis y, más coloquialmente, como ameba de fuego. Hay varias cifras a tener en cuenta a la hora de analizar sus niveles de resistencia. Para empezar, puede reproducirse por división celular hasta a 63ºC. A los 64ºC sigue activa, aunque ya no se reproduce. Después, a los 66ºC sigue parcialmente activa, aunque empieza a sufrir los efectos del calor. A los 70ºC ya se inactiva, pero aún puede volver a activarse. Sin embargo, a los 80ºC muere por completo.

Unlike the previous batch-based approach, where job completion indicated that a partition was ready, streaming ingestion continuously commits changes without an equivalent completion point.

articles.title: 250 000 dollars d'acompte et zéro garantie : la folle condition imposée par Tesla pour le nouveau Roadster
articles.summary:
On oublierait presque qu’il puisse aussi rouler au sol comme une voiture ordinaire. Capable des galipettes les plus impressionnantes qui soient, le nouveau Tesla Roadster tient véritablement de la science-fiction. La pirouette au-dessus d’un Semi ? Check. La promenade au plafond ? Check. Le 0 à 100 km/h sous la seconde ? Check. La livraison dans les temps ? Houlà, ça reste à prouver, d’autant plus que la livraison « tout court » n’est même pas garantie…

Un chèque de 250 000 $ versé… sans même connaître le prix final
En sachant qu’il faut débourser jusqu’à 250 000 $ pour effectuer la réservation, il y a de quoi l’avoir en travers de la gorge. Surtout que vous serez juste placé en liste d’attente lorsque Tesla sera enfin prêt à mettre les véhicules en production. Inutile donc d’espérer avoir l’engin dans votre garage à ce stade. Angel One, Zerodha expand US stock investing access for Indian investors
This reflects a broader push by Indian investment platforms to expand beyond domestic equities as retail investors seek exposure to global markets.
Angel One and Zerodha are expanding access to the US stock markets for Indian investors, as domestic brokerages look to tap into the growing demand for international equities and portfolio diversification.
Angel One has begun rolling out US stock investing on its app, allowing users to invest in US-listed stocks and exchange-traded funds (ETFs) alongside their Indian portfolios. The facility is currently available to a limited group of users, with a wider rollout expected by mid-November.
Investors will be able to buy shares of companies such as Apple, Microsoft, Alphabet, Amazon, Nvidia, Netflix, Spotify and Toyota. The platform will also support fractional investing, allowing users to purchase a portion of a share rather than an entire unit.
Meanwhile, Zerodha has also launched US stock investing in beta, offering access to around 2,000 US-listed stocks and 1,000 ETFs through its platform. The move gives Indian investors another avenue to access global businesses, particularly in sectors such as artificial intelligence, cloud computing, and semiconductors.
The expansion follows regulatory approval from the International Financial Services Centres Authority for brokers to offer international investing through GIFT City in Gujarat.

Dans les entreprises, l'utilisation de plusieurs produits Microsoft facilite leur déploiement, leur administration et leur sécurisation depuis un environnement commun. articles.title: Elon Musk promises to give a SpaceX share to the kids of America
articles.summary:
Elon Musk and Trump keep promising money to Americans…is this even allowed?
In a recent post on Twitter (X), Musk pledged to give every child in the U.S. a share of SpaceX next year.
Next year, I will give one of my SpaceX shares to every kid in America.
This will be the first of many.
— Elon Musk (@elonmusk) October 19, 2026
Musk owns about 6.4 billion SpaceX shares, according to regulatory filings. This is a 48.4 per cent beneficial stake in the company. However, according to a recent government census, the U.S. has 72 million children under 18 years old. And with a current stock price of US$146.03 (C$205), it would mean Musk would need to give away US$10.5 billion worth of shares, which is just a two per cent of his shares. The CEO followed up by saying, “This will be the first of many.”
Recently, AI startup company Anthropic said that it will commit 5 per cent of its shares to a new public benefit with promises to grow an additional 2 per cent for ever 50 per cent increase in the company’s value.
And while it could appear that Musk is competing with Anthropic, but the pledge comes alongside the midterm congressional elections in the U.S. The New York Times reports that Musk has spent US$366 million on the 2026 midterm election to support the Republicans, and this seems like the latest stunt.
Only to be upclassed by U.S. President Trump, who has claimed he will send a US$5000 (C$7,047) to each and every American — this one isn’t nearly realistic.
Source: Globe and Mail

articles.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool | TechCrunch
articles.summary:
On Monday, Amazon Web Services released a tool called TorchNeuron that lets AI startups easily move their AI apps onto Amazon’s AI chip, Trainium. In doing so, Amazon is also taking a direct stab at the software advantage that has helped Nvidia become the default hardware choice for AI apps and spurred its rise as AI hardware provider of choice.
TorchNeuron works with PyTorch, a free, open source toolkit that developers use to build, train, and run AI models. It lets AI apps written with PyTorch run on Trainium by changing just one line of configuration, according to Amazon — no code rewrite required.
Amazon says about 85% of AI apps are written with PyTorch. Facebook originally developed it, but since 2022, it has been part of the Linux Foundation, which maintains open source projects. Nvidia has spent years ensuring its CUDA software — the software infrastructure that allows apps to run on Nvidia GPUs and its other hardware — seamlessly supports AI apps written with PyTorch. As a result, Nvidia’s hardware is now deeply embedded in the toolkit, essentially by default.
TorchNeuron is adapted from PyTorch, so developers who know PyTorch already know how to use it. Amazon isn’t the first company to attempt to easily bring their chips to the platform. PyTorch users can also port their apps to AMD GPUs or even Apple’s chips with a simple configuration change.

articles.title: PSA: Patch your Plex media server before someone hacks it
articles.summary:
Recently fixed vulnerabilities in the Plex Media Server are under active exploitation in attacks that, when successful, install malware, including cryptominers and residential proxy apps, a researcher said.
Plex fixed four vulnerabilities at the start of last month. Three weeks later, published CVE designations revealed five vulnerabilities, with one of them carrying a severity rating of 8.6 out of 10. A researcher last week revealed an exploit that chained four of them together to achieve remote code execution of the device running a vulnerable Plex version. The researcher named the chain “Plex2Shell.”
Complex exploit chain
The new details allowed a separate researcher to create a honeypot that could track attempts in the wild to exploit the vulnerability chain. Within a day, the researcher began seeing active scanning of the simulated Plex server and eventually successful attempts to infect devices. So far, successful attacks are installing two payloads. One is a cryptominer, which uses the device to mine cryptocurrency and deposit it into a wallet controlled by the attacker. The other payload is residential proxy software, which allows people to anonymize their Internet activity (much of it illegal) by connecting to the infected box and then using it to send the user’s traffic to a final destination.
“Plex may be hosted on residential IP [sic] and I think threat actors would love to have residential IP proxy to access corporate VPNs and emails,” the second researcher wrote…

- Quand ? Départ prévu à 21h41 heure de Paris. Pour une arrivée en 2027 en orbite martienne, une récolte d’échantillons et un retour sur Terre en 2031.
- Où ? Le départ a lieu depuis la base spatiale de Tanegashima, une île au sud du Japon.

Lo más interesante es que no se trata de un porcentaje fijo, sino que se irá incrementando a medida que Anthropic crezca.
Un 5% con letra pequeña. El comunicado hecho público por Anthropic indica que la compañía destinará el 5% de sus acciones al Fondo de Beneficio Público, si lo aprueban los accionistas. Además, el consejo de administración de Anthropic podrá sumar otro 2% adicional por cada subida del 50% en la valoración de la empresa, sobre una capitalización base que aún no se ha desvelado, pero se estima que será la que tenga la compañía en su próxima salida a bolsa.

Le 16 octobre, le compte officiel d’Anthropic destiné aux développeurs a annoncé que c’était désormais chose faite, dans un message vu 2,7 millions de fois. Un historique qui repart à chaque message
Un assistant de programmation ne garde pas la discussion en mémoire côté serveur. À chaque nouvelle requête, tout l’historique repart sur le réseau : instructions, code, résultats des commandes précédentes. Sur une longue session de travail, le volume enfle vite, et le texte brut voyage d’autant plus lentement que la connexion est modeste.
Le texte se compresse remarquablement bien, d’autant plus s’il s’agit d’échanges avec un chatbot IA : un historique de conversation regorge de répétitions, noms de fichiers, structures de code, messages système, que l’algorithme encode une fois puis se contente de rappeler. La requête publiée fin août chiffrait le surcoût de calcul à quelques millisecondes par message, trois ordres de grandeur sous le temps de transfert économisé. articles.title: The science of deep sleep and how Duroflex Airboost helps you get more of it
articles.summary:
The science of deep sleep and how Duroflex Airboost helps you get more of it
India’s newest sleep technology is designed to enhance the N3 stage, the body’s repair shift, for better recovery, immunity, and stress resilience.
You can get enough sleep and still not get enough recovery.
We obsess over sleep duration, the “eight hours” metric, but duration alone doesn't tell the whole story. What matters just as much is depth. Deep sleep is the stage where the body does its heaviest lifting: repairing tissue, consolidating memory, and resetting the hormones that govern everything from appetite to stress. Yet for a growing number of people, deep sleep is the first thing to go missing, even when total sleep time looks normal on paper.
The different stages of sleep
Sleep isn't a single, uniform state. It cycles through distinct stages roughly every 90 minutes, each with a different job.
Light sleep (N1 and N2) acts as the transition zone; the body slows down, heart rate drops, and brain activity shifts into slower rhythms. This stage makes up the bulk of a typical night, but it's largely preparatory.
Deep sleep, or N3 stage (also called slow-wave sleep), is where the real restorative work happens. Brain waves slow dramatically, blood pressure and breathing reach their lowest points, and the body redirects energy toward physical repair, regenerating muscle, strengthening the immune system, and clearing metabolic waste from the brain.

articles.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as 'frontier models can't be trusted' | TechCrunch
articles.summary:
Microsoft on Monday introduced new security features designed to protect enterprises from the growing threat of AI agents. The launch comes as Microsoft continues to warn enterprises about the dangers of AI and agents.
Perhaps the most notable addition is Guardian Agents, a new feature intended to monitor the AI agents a company uses. Guardian Agents is part of Project Perception, a product introduced in June.
Project Perception was Microsoft’s answer to powerful hacking models like Anthropic’s Mythos and Fable and OpenAI’s security vulnerability scanning system Daybreak. Project Perception originally launched three classes of agents: a “red team” that acted like hackers and attacked, a “blue team” that detected the red team and assessed the vulnerabilities they found, and a “green team” tasked with fixing them.
The product was designed around the assumption that AI hackers would come from outside the company. But lately, Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella has been warning that the AI enemy may be the very agents enterprises have deployed and are paying for, much like a rogue human employee, otherwise known as an “insider threat.”
Earlier this month, in his private blog, Nadella warned that it’s time to stop trusting AI model providers, even if they offer assurances of safety and security with their agentic products. He wants enterprises to implement separate systems, not controlled by the AI labs, to watch and control the agents that those AI labs’ products launch.

Versteckte Lügen und falsche Anweisungen: Diese Programmiersprache soll KI verwirren
Zahlreiche KI-Modelle sind in der Lage, Code für diverse Projekte zu generieren. Sie unterstützen dabei Programmierer:innen im Alltag, wenn auch nicht immer zu 100 Prozent und können Laien trotz fehlender Coding-Skills zum Ziel bringen. Programmierer Dominik Picheta, der früher bei Meta tätig war und jetzt bei Cloudflare arbeitet, hat sich die Frage gestellt, ob KI-Agenten dabei wirklich den Code verstehen können oder einfach nur Schnipsel wiederholen, die ihnen antrainiert wurden.
Eine Programmiersprache für Menschen, nicht für KI
Deshalb hat der Coder eine neue Programmiersprache namens „Killswitch“ erfunden. Sie vereint mehrere Prämissen, die es KI-Modellen erschweren sollen, sie zu verstehen. Zunächst beinhaltet Killswitch „versteckte Lügen“, die sich von Menschen schnell als Lügen enttarnen, KI aber verzweifeln lassen sollen. Killswitch geht nämlich davon aus, dass Leser:innen „Ableitungen vornehmen können, statt alles erklärt zu bekommen.“
Die einzelnen Programmierelemente wie Entrypoints und Funktionen werden als kurze Sätze formuliert, wobei die Anzahl der Buchstaben entscheidend ist, damit sie vom lesenden Programm umgesetzt werden. La France décroche la première place du classement nPerf du débit descendant fixe, donc en téléchargement, parmi les pays à richesse comparable. Au troisième trimestre 2026, l’Hexagone dépasse les 360 Mbit/s de moyenne, loin devant plusieurs grandes nations européennes.
Le débit descendant fixe de la France, autrement dit sa vitesse de téléchargement, fait la course en tête apprend-on ce lundi 19 octobre puisqu'entre juillet et septembre 2026, l'Hexagone a pris la première place du classement nPerf réservé aux pays à richesse comparable. La plateforme indépendante, nourrie par des millions de tests de connexion chaque année, a passé au crible les nations dont le PIB par habitant se situe entre 35 000 et 60 000 dollars. Dans le top 10, l’écart entre la tête et le dernier classé dépasse les 240 Mbit/s !
360 Mbit/s, le chiffre qui place la France sur la première marche
Avec 360,20 Mbit/s (mégabits par seconde) en moyenne sur réseau fixe, la France devance la Slovénie (316,45 Mbit/s) d'environ 44 Mbit/s, puis le Canada (292,46 Mbit/s). L'Espagne, quatrième avec 265,72 Mbit/s, garde une sérieuse marge sur le Royaume-Uni (174,85 Mbit/s) et l'Italie (173,01 Mbit/s). articles.title: Batteries help reduce emissions, but how do we reduce their emissions?
articles.summary:
The first order of business for the energy transition is electrifying applications like vehicles and heating and making sure that the electricity that powers them is made using renewables. But once the dominant slices of the emissions pie have shrunk, other categories with less potential to reduce emissions become important.
A new study led by Haiwei Zhou at the University of Melbourne focused on the emissions associated with making lithium-ion batteries, which many parts of the energy transition rely on. Those emissions aren’t zero, so as we use more and more batteries, that number will grow. Right now, the researchers estimate that these emissions only account for 0.18 percent of annual greenhouse gas releases, but they could increase by a factor of 10 or more by 2050.
Avoiding production
There are a number of ways to reduce the emissions required to make a battery. Some elements used in various lithium-ion battery chemistries are more energy-intensive to mine and refine than others. The battery manufacturing process involves many steps that could be made more energy-efficient. And then there’s recycling, which can put battery materials back into the loop while requiring much less energy than mining.
But the researchers wanted to compare options on the demand side of the equation. Rather than shaving the per-battery carbon footprint, this means reducing the number of batteries we need to make, avoiding their emissions entirely.

articles.title: « Pare-chocs contre pare-chocs » : après des semaines de manœuvres, un satellite militaire russe a rattrapé un satellite radar lié à l’Ukraine
articles.summary:
En orbite basse, on ne s’approche normalement pas d’un autre satellite sans y avoir été invité. C’est pourtant ce qu’a fait Cosmos 2612 au cours des derniers jours. Le 16 octobre, la société américaine de surveillance spatiale LeoLabs a indiqué à Axios que le satellite militaire russe se trouvait à environ 5 kilomètres d’ICEYE-X36, alors que plus de 320 kilomètres les séparaient la veille. Une approche qui « semble délibérée », selon l’entreprise. Et le rapprochement ne s’est pas arrêté là.
D’après l’astronome néerlandais Marco Langbroek, qui suit les satellites militaires depuis des années, les deux engins pourraient être passés à « quelques centaines de mètres » l’un de l’autre, voire beaucoup moins, dans la nuit du 17 au 18 octobre, vers 3 h 35 heure de Paris. Il est impossible d’être plus précis : les données orbitales publiques comportent une marge d’erreur, et Cosmos 2612 semble avoir encore effectué de petites manœuvres autour de ce moment, explique-t-il sur son blog.
Pour mesurer l’anomalie de la situation, un professeur de droit spatial à l’université du Mississippi, Aaron Brynildson, explique que les États évitent généralement de s’approcher à moins d’une dizaine de kilomètres d’un autre satellite. En deçà, si les deux engins manœuvrent en même temps, le risque de collision augmente fortement. How a FD calculator helps investors plan savings with ease
Saving for life’s big goals? Start with an FD calculator: Bajaj Finance’s online tool lets you compare amounts, tenures, and payout options instantly, turning guesswork into clear savings plans.

articles.title: 9 Minuten Laden, 90 Minuten Arbeit: Neue Akkus sollen den Digits 5 zum echten Haushaltshelfer machen
articles.summary:
9 Minuten Laden, 90 Minuten Arbeit: Neue Akkus sollen den Digits 5 zum echten Haushaltshelfer machen
Der humanoide Roboter Digit 5 von Agility Robotics hat eine besonders lange Laufzeit bei kurzem Aufladen. Die Batterietechnik dafür liefert das Unternehmen Nyobolt. Damit kommt der Roboter auf ein Verhältnis von Laufzeit zu Ladezeit von ungefähr 10:1. Für jede Minute an der Ladestation stehen also zehn Minuten Arbeit zur Verfügung. Lädt man neun Minuten, läuft der Humanoid 90 Minuten. Der Vorgänger Digit 4 schaffte lediglich ein Verhältnis von 2:1 – er verbrachte rund ein Drittel des Tages am Ladegerät.
Warum Akkus bei Humanoiden das Hauptproblem sind
Humanoide Roboter brauchen viel Strom. Weil sie sich frei bewegen sollen, kommt der aus Batterien. Die halten allerdings nicht lange und müssen regelmäßig nachgeladen oder getauscht werden. Agility Robotics setzt deshalb auf besonders leichte Akkus mit hoher Leistungsdichte, die also viel Energie pro Kilogramm abgeben können.
Mit der neuen Technik könne Digit 5 täglich mehr als zwei komplette Arbeitsschichten absolvieren, teilt Agility Robotics mit. Die Auslastung einer Roboterflotte im Unternehmen steige dadurch deutlich. Die Akkus von Nyobolt sollen zudem viele Ladezyklen überstehen. Konkrete Zahlen nannten allerdings weder Agility Robotics noch Nyobolt: Weder zur Kapazität noch zur Zahl der möglichen Ladevorgänge gibt es Angaben.
Warum kein Wechselakku?

articles.title: Canadian publishers launch copyright suit against AI company Anthropic
articles.summary:
A group of Canada’s largest publishers are suing AI company Anthropic in the Ontario court. The publishers, which include Postmedia, Torstar, The Globe and Mail, and the Canadian Press, claim that Anthropic infringed on their copyright by using their content to develop Claude. The lawsuit was filed on Oct. 6, and initially reported by Cartt.
“Anthropic has capitalized on the commercial success of its AI models, building an expansive suite of services, and raised significant capital — all without obtaining a valid licence from any of the News Media Companies,” says the statement of claim.
The claim indicates that Anthropic breached and circumvented the protection measures put in place to prevent copying of their content. Additionally, it says that Anthropic accesses and copies a lot of text data from the internet and the Plaintiff’s websites. Anthropic then allegedly uses that content without authorization or consent to train its AI models. Further, the lawsuit indicates that Anthropic scrapes content on an ongoing basis because of ongoing user prompts.
These publishers have been trying to get the federal government to take a stand on how AI companies use copyrighted content after the national AI strategy failed to address the problem.
The allegations have yet to be proven in court. The same publishers and CBC launched a lawsuit against OpenAI in 2024, which has also not been settled.
Source: Global News

articles.title: Embedded AI evaluators won't be an easy solution, Hugging Face's policy chief says | TechCrunch
articles.summary:
AI labs have staked their reputations on model benchmarking — the supposedly neutral and accurate system of evaluations that are designed to measure whether one AI product is better than another.
However, the methods behind these evaluations are complicated and still maturing, said Irene Solaiman, Hugging Face’s chief policy officer, during a discussion at TechCrunch Disrupt last week. Testing needs to come together into a more consistent science if the industry is to rely on them in the future.
With that in mind, can we trust the current tests that are being released?
“Trust is such a weighted term,” said Solaiman. “In terms of whether we can trust results, one big part [of that] is can you reproduce the results of an evaluation? Do you have the level of access that you need to the model itself — this is where open weights come in in a big way,” she added.
Reproducibility in model evaluations has long remained one of the stickier aspects of benchmarking — and remains a topic of significant debate in the industry.
Outside of an individual test’s validity, there’s also the added question of how that test compares to other evaluations.
“They are an evolving science — where we don’t know how to meaningfully compare them to each other,” Solaiman said.

The petition, which was posted by resident Kevin Fifield, calls the decision to build the data centre as “a decision that significantly impacts our environment, our power grid, and our community at large.”
According to CBC News, the data centre in question is a proposed data centre just outside Port Hawkesbury in Cape Breton, Nova Scotia. EverWind Fuels, a renewable energy company based in Halifax, will own the facility, and Anthropic will lease it to power Claude.
The company noted it will build the facility in two stages, with the first phase coming online by the end of 2027 and the second in 2028. Both companies say they will pay for any required upgrades to the province’s electricity system, and EverWind has raised $8 billion in private capital.

articles.title: Russian spacecraft maneuvers in "extreme proximity" to satellite used by Ukraine
articles.summary:
A Russian military satellite maneuvered in “extreme proximity” of a commercial Earth-imaging satellite in recent days in the first known example an unsanctioned rendezvous in low-Earth orbit, according to the orbital intelligence company LeoLabs.
The Russian spacecraft, Kosmos 2612, “conducted a deliberate series of maneuvers toward ICEYE-X36, a US-operated commercial imaging satellite,” LeoLabs said. “Kosmos 2612 closed from hundreds of kilometers away to extreme proximity to ICEYE-X36. It then maneuvered around ICEYE-X36, remained nearby for an extended period, and then began moving away.”
US military officials and independent analysts have tracked Kosmos 2612 since its April launch on a Soyuz rocket from a spaceport in northern Russia. Within weeks, it became apparent that at least four of the six satellites from that launch were stalking ICEYE-X36 after they adjusted orbits to line up with the orbit of the ICEYE spacecraft.
Russia’s modus operandi
The situation remained stable until last week, when Kosmos 2612 began rapidly moving toward ICEYE-X36. By Friday, Kosmos 2612 was holding station 2 to 3 kilometers away before shifting positions ahead of and behind the ICEYE satellite, LeoLabs said. The satellites were within 500 meters (1,640 feet) of one another over the weekend, and “likely quite a bit closer than that,” said Adam Marsh, LeoLabs’ vice president of technical solutions.

FBI warns of torrent of scams and deepfakes ahead of US midterm elections
Hackers and scammers are trying to steal data and cash
- Hackers and fraudsters are already gearing up to steal data and financial information in the run up to the US midterm elections
- AI generated imagery and deepfakes are part of highly convincing scams
- Phishing campaigns designed to prey on voter registration are also likely to pop up
As the US midterms rapidly approach, the FBI is once again warning Americans about the flood of election-related scam campaigns coming their way.
Thousands of websites have already been spotted getting ready to spool up for election season, with phishing sites, fake donation portals, and Doppelganger clones also emerging as November draws closer.
Finances and personal data are both at risk, the FBI has warned, with many campaigns leveraging new AI technologies to make scams even more convincing.
Scammers leveraging AI and deepfakes

As of October 19, Pennsylvania had reported 1,286 measles cases this year across 42 counties. articles.title: Alerte maximale dans le cloud : une faille critique de Linux menace l’étanchéité des serveurs
articles.summary:
Une vulnérabilité découverte dans le noyau Linux menace l’isolation des machines virtuelles sur les serveurs KVM. Baptisée PwnEscape et notée 9,3/10 en gravité, elle pousse déjà plusieurs hébergeurs à prendre des mesures d’urgence.
Pour un hébergeur cloud, l’une des pires situations serait de voir un client prendre le contrôle du serveur qui héberge ses machines virtuelles. C’est précisément le risque soulevé par PwnEscape (CVE-2026-99999), une faille critique du noyau Linux révélée par les chercheurs de pwn.ai.
Le problème concerne les infrastructures utilisant KVM, une technologie de virtualisation largement répandue sous Linux. Dans les configurations exposées, un attaquant disposant de privilèges élevés dans une machine virtuelle peut exploiter son interface réseau virtuelle de type virtio pour franchir les protections qui l’isolent du serveur hôte. Il pourrait alors compromettre ce serveur et, potentiellement, les ressources d’autres clients.
Une simple erreur réseau ouvre une brèche dans Linux
La faille ne se trouve pas directement dans KVM, mais dans la manière dont Linux traite certains paquets réseau. Lorsqu’une machine virtuelle transmet des données, elle peut confier au noyau de l’hôte le calcul de leur somme de contrôle, une opération destinée à vérifier l’intégrité des informations échangées.

articles.title: Intel Readies XMX-Accelerated XeSS Support for Valve's Proton Compatibility Layer
articles.summary:
Monday, October 19th 2026
Intel Readies XMX-Accelerated XeSS Support for Valve's Proton Compatibility Layer
Intel is preparing to add support for XeSS, accelerated by XMX cores in its graphics cards, to Valve's Proton compatibility layer. This is great news because the Valve Proton layer currently uses a slower version of the upscaler that is not very efficient. The XMX cores would significantly accelerate upscaling and bring substantial performance improvements. Intel is promoting XeSS and its latest version 3.0, which features multi-frame generation (MFG). This version integrates up to three generated frames between two rendered frames, resulting in up to a fourfold increase in frame rate using MFG, similar to NVIDIA's DLSS MFG technology. Intel is joining the trend of AI-generated frame insertion, which seems to be gradually expanding.
Looking at the latest "Panther Lake" SoC with Xe3 cores, each Xe3 core includes eight vector engines, eight matrix engines (XMX), and a dedicated ray tracing unit. These execution units now operate with higher utilization thanks to refined thread dispatch and load balancing. The vector and matrix engines double peak FP16 and INT8 throughput compared to Xe2, benefiting both traditional rendering and AI-assisted tasks such as denoising, upscaling, and frame generation. Hence, supporting XMX-accelerated XeSS will finally give Intel Xe gamers on Linux a much-needed performance bump.

NiCE bets the company on AI, data and accountability, and the legacy business buys it time
Every company in the customer experience ecosystem now claims to be an artificial intelligence company. Last week, at NiCE Ltd.’s annual industry analyst summit, the company demonstrated what happens when an AI strategy shifts the organization’s center of gravity.
A year after closing the Cognigy acquisition, NiCE is no longer a contact center-as-a-service or CCaaS provider with AI bolted on. It’s an AI platform that happens to include the industry’s deepest CCaaS and workforce engagement stack. Even before the Cognigy purchase, I felt NiCE led the CCaaS industry, and the event only reinforced that view.
Cognigy is now the heart of NiCE

Por ejemplo, el inconfundible olor a orina rancia se debe fundamentalmente al amoniaco, y este compuesto se produce cuando la ureasa bacteriana hidroliza la urea de la orina. Dicho proceso biológico no solo causa mal olor, sino que sube el pH del medio y provoca la precipitación de sales, formando el temido "sarro de orina" que se queda casi incrustado.

Microsoft Corp. today introduced security controls for rogue artificial intelligence agents that cut back what an agent may do as its assessed risk climbs.
The release takes on what Hayete Gallot, executive vice president of Microsoft Security, called the “agentic insider” in a blog post. Enterprise agents are often overprivileged, and their numbers are growing fast. Gallot argued that frontier models cannot be fully trusted because they are built to chase results. Some will reach a goal in ways nobody intended, she wrote, including by colluding with other agents.
Microsoft Chairman and Chief Executive Satya Nadella laid out the thinking behind the controls in an Oct. 10 essay that urged companies to treat models as insider risks, with safeguards kept outside the model itself. The most trustworthy system, he wrote, will be “the one that enables us to trust the model the least.”
The controls start with finding agents. Microsoft’s discovery tools can now spot 60 types of local agents on employee machines after 35 were added. The list includes Anthropic PBC’s Claude Code and OpenAI Group PBC’s Codex, as well as GitHub Copilot from Microsoft’s own GitHub unit. The company is also extending Microsoft Entra Agent ID to give those agents, and unknown ones its sensors find, identities of their own.

Amazon introduces toolkit for running PyTorch workloads on AWS Trainium chips
Amazon.com Inc. today introduced TorchNeuron, an open-source toolkit that enables developers to run PyTorch workloads on its AWS Trainium chips.
PyTorch is the industry’s most popular artificial intelligence development framework. Until now, running AI projects powered by the tool on Trainium-based Amazon Web Services instances involved a significant amount of manual work. That increased development costs and thereby created an entry barrier for users.
TorchNeuron makes it possible to run PyTorch projects on Trainium chips without extensive code changes. According to Amazon, developers only have to configure a setting that informs workloads which chip they should use. TorchNeuron supports Trainium2 and Trainium3, the two latest additions to the accelerator series. The chips support both training and inference use cases.
Trainium3, the more capable of the two processors, features eight computing cores. Each core comprises four modules that are each optimized for a different subset of the calculations with which AI models process data. The chip keeps model data in a 154-gigabyte pool of onboard memory.
AWS runs Trainium3 in custom servers that can each accommodate up to 144 accelerators. According to the Amazon unit, a single system can perform up to 362 quadrillion calculations per second when processing data in the MXFP8 format. The format is widely used by AI models.

“The question here is really, how do you balance the speed of innovation with the implementation of governance?”

articles.title: Trump administration orders ban on DeepSeek in federal agencies - SiliconANGLE
articles.summary:
Trump administration orders ban on DeepSeek in federal agencies
The Department of Homeland Security has ordered artificial intelligence technology from the Chinese company DeepSeek Ltd. be removed from all federal civilian agencies.
The order, published on the Federal Register website today, warned that DeepSeek’s AI models present “multiple threat vectors,” that could give the Chinese Communist Party “extensive authority” to access American government infrastructure.
DeepSeek doesn’t even make the top 10 in a recent government survey where people expressed their opinion of AI models, but in 2025 the free app was downloaded by millions of Americans to the consternation of the U.S government. At the time a full ban of the app was mulled in the U.S., with one cybersecurity expert calling DeepSeek’s privacy policy not “worth the paper it is written on.”
The new order from the DHS means all civilian agency information technology systems will now have to remove all any products affiliated with DeepSeek from their systems, which includes third-party services developed using the app. Going forward, all purchases of DeepSeek’s products and services are verboten in those agencies. The DHS justified the move by invoking the 2018 Federal Acquisition Supply Chain Security Act following a review of the matter by the Federal Acquisition Security Council.

articles.title: Instalar la APK de XUPER TV en Android trae mucha publicidad y malware que roba contraseñas bancarias
articles.summary:
La descarga de XUPER TV mediante archivos APK externos implica riesgos que exceden la resolución de películas, series o transmisiones en vivo. La aplicación no se distribuye en Google Play Store, así que la instalación depende de páginas de terceros, sin garantías sobre el origen, la integridad o las modificaciones realizadas al archivo.
Ese circuito puede derivar en publicidad invasiva, ralentización del celular, pedidos de permisos que no corresponden con una plataforma streaming y la descarga de programas adicionales.
El Instituto Nacional de Ciberseguridad de España (Incibe) advierte que las aplicaciones maliciosas pueden robar información, bloquear archivos, registrar pulsaciones y acceder a mensajes de texto con códigos de verificación.
Por qué una APK puede traer publicidad invasiva
Una APK es el archivo de instalación de las aplicaciones de Android. El problema aparece cuando se descarga desde sitios no oficiales: el usuario no puede comprobar si se trata de la versión original, una copia modificada o un instalador que incorpora componentes adicionales.
En el caso de XUPER TV, la falta de una distribución verificable deja esa comprobación en manos de quien descarga el archivo. Una de las consecuencias habituales es la aparición de anuncios fuera de la aplicación, redirecciones a sitios web y ventanas emergentes.

Dream Labs raises $90M to help build more intelligent robots with simple video feeds
Dream Labs, a startup trying to make robots more intelligent and capable of performing many different tasks, has raised $90 million in seed funding to coincide with the launch of a public application programming interface that provides access to its universal robot foundation model.
Today’s round was jointly led by B Capital and Kindred Ventures and saw the participation of others including A.Capital, Unusual Ventures, Wing VC, SV Angel, Scribble VC and angel investor Adrian Aoun.
Dream Labs is taking aim at the lack of intelligence in today’s robots, which might be fairly numerous in many environments but are also fairly limited. The startup believes there are more than 5 million industrial robots working inside factories and warehouses globally. These robots surely do perform useful work, otherwise their owners wouldn’t have invested in them, but Dream Labs co-founder and Chief Executive Joel Jang believes they should be able to do so much more.
What’s stopping them is a lack of expertise and knowledge. Almost all of those 5 million robots are designed to perform a single task, which they do very well. But they cannot be trained to do any other task, nor can they pass on their acquired knowledge to train other robots and machines.

Russian bot activity plunged 84% after Ukraine hit Yandex data centers, but the bots were back at full strength within two days
Day-long bot collapse saw major drop in traffic
- Ukraine's CCD says suspected Russian bot posts in its sample fell 83.6% on October 8 after a strike shut Yandex's Sasovo data center
- The same data shows volume back above pre-strike levels by October 10, with a smaller 42.6% dip after the Vladimir shutdown
- Cloudflare and Graphika found no comparable drop in Western political communities, though Russian-language Telegram output fell 5% to 15%
Ukraine's Center for Countering Disinformation (CCD) says suspected Russian bot accounts went almost silent after drones knocked out Yandex data centers earlier this month, with message volume across a monitored network falling 83.6% in a single day.
The findings come from an analytical report the CCD dated October 15 2026. Using Osavul monitoring software, analysts tracked 22,664 messages from 5,201 accounts showing signs of inauthentic behavior across 26 topics in Ukraine's Facebook and Telegram space between October 6 and 12.
The 83.6% figure is real, but the same report shows those accounts posting more than before within 48 hours, and independent data from Cloudflare shows that at least some of the malicious automation running on Yandex's cloud did not die so much as move house.

articles.title: Cómo usar Windows RE: el salvavidas oculto de Microsoft cuando cuando Windows deja de funcionar en el PC
articles.summary:
Windows no siempre arranca como debería, y cuando eso ocurre no hace falta recurrir a un técnico ni reinstalar el sistema desde cero. Existe una herramienta integrada que puede resolver buena parte de esos problemas sin perder archivos ni configuraciones.
Se trata de Windows RE, abreviatura de Windows Recovery Environment o entorno de recuperación de Windows. Viene preinstalado de forma predeterminada en Windows 10 y Windows 11, en todas sus ediciones de escritorio, así como en Windows Server 2016 y versiones posteriores.
Windows RE es el entorno de recuperación que permite reparar las causas más comunes de los sistemas operativos que no logran arrancar, sin necesidad de reinstalar Windows desde cero ni perder archivos personales. Funciona como un sistema operativo complementario que carga solo lo necesario para diagnosticar y corregir fallos.
La herramienta se basa en el Entorno de preinstalación de Windows, conocido como Windows PE, y puede personalizarse con controladores adicionales, idiomas extra y componentes opcionales. No debe confundirse con el modo seguro de Windows, aunque ambos cumplen funciones similares de diagnóstico.
Cuándo conviene usar Windows RE
Conviene acceder a Windows RE ante problemas críticos que impiden usar el escritorio con normalidad. El caso más habitual es un equipo atrapado en un bucle de reinicios o que muestra una pantalla negra o azul antes de llegar al inicio de sesión.

articles.title: Cada cuántos días se deben cambiar todas las contraseñas de redes sociales y correos
articles.summary:
Cambiar las contraseñas puede reducir los riesgos de acceso no autorizado, pero la frecuencia adecuada depende de la solidez de cada clave y del tipo de cuenta protegida. Redes sociales, servicios bancarios, plataformas de trabajo y aplicaciones con información sensible requieren contraseñas únicas, robustas y difíciles de descifrar.
Una clave simple, de hasta siete caracteres, puede caer en manos de un cibercriminal en apenas dos segundos mediante herramientas automatizadas.El hábito de actualizar credenciales tiene incluso una fecha dedicada en Estados Unidos: cada 1 de febrero se celebra el Change Your Password Day.
De acuerdo con Eset, el cambio periódico puede ser útil, aunque no existe una regla única para todos los usuarios y servicios. La empresa de ciberseguridad recomienda analizar la composición de la contraseña, la importancia de la cuenta y la existencia de posibles filtraciones antes de decidir cuándo renovarla.
La regla de los 90 días no siempre ofrece más seguridad
Durante años se extendió la recomendación de modificar las contraseñas cada 90 días. Sin embargo, esta práctica no garantiza por sí sola una mejora relevante de la seguridad. El especialista Lance Spitzner, en un análisis publicado por Sans, considera que el beneficio es reducido frente al costo que implica para las empresas obligar a sus usuarios o empleados a renovar las claves con frecuencia.

articles.title: Amazon Ships Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 With an Intel CPU Hiding Underneath
articles.summary:
Monday, October 19th 2026
Amazon Ships Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 With an Intel CPU Hiding Underneath
A Reddit user in the r/watercooling subreddit bought an AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D2 Dual Edition from Amazon and noticed that something was off. This was his second 9950X3D2 chip, and both chips were sold and shipped by Amazon and arrived in sealed retail boxes, with identical markings on the heat spreader. Flip them over, however, and the newer one looks nothing like the first. It has a large empty area in the middle packed with tiny capacitors, while a genuine AM5 Ryzen chip has gold contact pads covering nearly its entire underside. The user initially assumed AMD had quietly revised the design. Commenters thought otherwise, and the top reply suggests that someone delidded a real 9950X3D2, attached its heat spreader to an old Intel processor, and sent the fake back to Amazon for a refund. That chip has now ended up in our Redditor's hands.
In this case, the layout is a big giveaway, since Intel desktop chips place many of their capacitors on the underside of the substrate, whereas AMD keeps them on top to leave room for contacts. The lettering on the fake also looks smudged, possibly from the delid or a reprint. It's still unclear which Intel CPU sits underneath, and there's no word from Amazon so far on the matter. That's a costly mistake too, considering the 9950X3D2 launched at $899. Amazon has been here before, apparently, with reports of a fake Ryzen 7 9800X3D that turned out to be a 2…

articles.title: NVIDIA's Faster DLSS 5 Model Gets Pulled From NBA 2K27, Modders Report Up to 90% Gains
articles.summary:
Monday, October 19th 2026
NVIDIA's Faster DLSS 5 Model Gets Pulled From NBA 2K27, Modders Report Up to 90% Gains
NVIDIA shipped its faster DLSS 5 Neural Rendering model with NBA 2K27 on October 16, and it didn't take modders long to pull it out and test it elsewhere. Renan Maniero on X extracted the new 310.9.16.0 build of the DLL. That lets people inject it into games that don't officially support DLSS 5 through tools like RenoDX and OptiScaler. The new DLL also keeps the older model around as Preset A, with the new one sitting under Preset B, so comparing the two is as simple as switching presets. Gaming Optimized on X did exactly that, and found the new model running up to 90% faster than the old one in The Witcher 3. The channel points out that the gain varies from game to game, so 90% looks like the best case rather than the norm. 
That roughly aligns with NVIDIA's own claims. The company says the October update shrinks the model by 24% to roughly 118 million parameters, cuts VRAM use at 4K by 20%, and runs the neural rendering workload up to 2x faster than the September version. NVIDIA also quoted up to 40% higher frame rates in NBA 2K27 specifically. Officially, DLSS 5 is still limited to RTX 50-series GPUs and GeForce NOW. NVIDIA plans to bring it to the RTX 40-series, though there's no date yet, and there's no word on RTX 30 or RTX 20 support. Estos códigos aparecen en parquímetros, restaurantes, carteles, facturas y anuncios, por lo que se han convertido en un recurso habitual para realizar pagos, consultar información o abrir sitios web desde el teléfono.
El riesgo surge cuando un delincuente sustituye un código legítimo por otro diseñado para engañar. La Comisión Federal de Consumidores de Estados Unidos advierte sobre casos en los que estafadores cubrieron los códigos QR de parquímetros con versiones falsas. Al escanearlas, la víctima puede terminar en una web fraudulenta y entregar información bancaria o personal. La revisión del enlace antes de abrirlo es la primera medida de protección.
Los peligros de escanear códigos QR
Pagar un estacionamiento mediante un código QR parece una opción rápida. El usuario escanea la imagen, abre una página de pago e introduce sus datos. Sin embargo, este procedimiento puede facilitar una estafa si alguien colocó un adhesivo falso encima del código original.
El código malicioso puede llevar a un sitio que imita la apariencia de una plataforma de pagos. Allí, el delincuente puede solicitar el número de tarjeta, datos personales, contraseñas o información de contacto. También puede intentar instalar programas maliciosos en el dispositivo.

articles.title: Modder Builds "Slurptop" Cyberdeck with Full Height Keyboard, Swappable Tool Batteries, and Trackball
articles.summary:
Tuesday, October 20th 2026
Modder Builds "Slurptop" Cyberdeck with Full Height Keyboard, Swappable Tool Batteries, and Trackball
The concept of a cyberdeck is to customize hardware to better suit your specific needs and use cases, and a modder who goes by "Slurp Burgers" online has taken the concept to something of an extreme, with their take on a laptop, the Slurptop. Unlike many DIY cyberdeck builds, which are based on Raspberry Pi computers, the Slurptop uses a full-fat AMD Ryzen 7 7730U in the motherboard from a GMKtec M5 Ultra mini PC. As a result, it has somewhat better I/O than a traditional laptop, although the mini PC's three front USB Type-C ports were all used to connect the display and peripherals internally.

articles.title: L'informatique quantique va-t-elle rendre obsolète toute la cryptographie actuelle des PME ?
articles.summary:
Des pirates informatiques stockent des données chiffrées dans plusieurs secteurs, en attendant qu'un ordinateur quantique suffisamment puissant puisse les déchiffrer. Si les PME françaises ne sont pas concernées par cette menace avant plusieurs années, l'ANSSI impose aux fournisseurs de logiciels et de matériel des échéances précises pour engager la transition. Voici ce qui est en jeu, sans dramatisation inutile.
Vos sauvegardes, votre messagerie professionnelle et vos connexions VPN sont chiffrées par RSA ou par les courbes elliptiques. Depuis la fin des années 1970, RSA est utilisé pour la sécurité de la plupart des connexions internet. Les courbes elliptiques constituent une famille d'algorithmes plus récente. Dans les deux cas, la sécurité dépend d'un calcul mathématique différent.
Un ordinateur classique ne résout pas ces calculs en un temps raisonnable, alors qu'un ordinateur quantique suffisamment puissant peut les résoudre en quelques heures grâce à l'algorithme de Shor. Aucune machine ne peut aujourd'hui exécuter cet algorithme sur des clés de la taille utilisée en production, mais des attaquants conservent des échanges chiffrés dans l'espoir de les déchiffrer une fois cette machine disponible.

articles.title: OpenCode Console Breach May Have Exposed OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API Keys
articles.summary:
An intruder reached a legacy system at OpenCode on the night of October 16 and may have exposed the third-party AI provider keys that users had saved in OpenCode Console, the company said.
Console is OpenCode's optional hosted service: a workspace saves its own OpenAI, Anthropic, or Google key there, and Console uses that key to call the provider so team members can use the models without ever seeing the key.
The affected group is 1.4% of Console users, all of whom have an outside provider linked, and OpenCode has told them via email to revoke those keys with each provider and replace them.
The email went out on the morning of October 17 under the subject line "Action Required: Potential provider key breach." Anyone who did not get one was not affected, OpenCode said in a post on X later that day.
The keys at risk are the ones pasted into Console. The OpenCode command-line and desktop apps keep provider keys added on the machine in a SQLite database there. The breach involves "the OpenCode Console, not OpenCode itself," co-founder Dax Raad wrote in a reply on X, and those keys "never come to us."
A provider key is a bearer credential: whoever holds a copy can run billable requests against the owner's account until the provider revokes it. Deleting the key from Console does not revoke it, and a Console budget cannot cap that use either, because Console only sees requests that pass through its own gateway.

Des mesures de prévention strictes

articles.title: Unpatched Broadcom Wi-Fi Flaw Lets Attackers in Range Run Code as Root on Routers
articles.summary:
A flaw in Broadcom's Wi-Fi setup software lets an attacker within radio range run code as root on Broadcom-based routers, without the network password or any pairing step, security researcher Quentin Kaiser disclosed on October 16.
He showed the attack working against home gateways supplied by three Belgian internet providers, in one case reading the Wi-Fi password off the device and in another opening a remote shell over the air. No CVE has been assigned to the flaw, and no fix has been deployed to the affected routers, Kaiser says.
The flaw is in Broadcom's version of Wi-Fi Protected Setup (WPS), the feature that lets a device join a Wi-Fi network without the password being typed in. Broadcom's code mishandles the reassembly of fragmented WPS setup messages, so an attacker in range can send crafted messages that corrupt the router's memory. From there, Kaiser built two things: a way to read memory back off the device, and a way to run his own code on it.
Against an Orange Belgium gateway, the Askey TCG3000 read the Wi-Fi password (the PSK) from the router's stored settings, sent it back over the air, and then joined the network with it.
Against a Proximus gateway, the Sagemcom-built BBOX3V+, the exploit opened a reverse shell, a remote command line, carried over Wi-Fi frames, so no outside server was needed.
Both ran without any login, and the attack works at a distance, not only up close, Kaiser says. He reports no real-world attacks using the flaw. The working exploits ar…

articles.title: ReactOS, le Windows open source, s'invite sur les partitions NTFS
articles.summary:
ReactOS n'est plus limité au FAT32 : le clone open source de Windows peut désormais s'installer sur une partition NTFS. Son nouveau pilote peut d'ailleurs également formater un disque dans ce format.
ReactOS a récemment annoncé que son pilote NTFS était assez abouti pour installer et faire tourner le système. Le projet, toujours en alpha, s'approche peu à peu d'une première bêta.
Un pilote qui installe et formate, mais sans cache ni journal
Le système de fichiers NTFS date de Windows NT 3.1 en 1993, et sa version arrivée avec XP en 2001 est toujours utilisée par la plupart des systèmes Windows. Jusqu'ici, ReactOS devait être installé sur une partition FAT32. Or les développeurs ont pour but de rendre le projet compatible avec les binaires de Windows Server 2003. ReactOS doit donc être capable de faire tourner tels quels les programmes et pilotes de ce système. La tâche était beaucoup trop complexe en restant sur du FAT32.
Et le moins qu'on puisse dire, c'est que le chantier est long. La lecture seule du NTFS est arrivée en 2016, puis le chargeur de démarrage FreeLoader (le programme qui lance ReactOS) a su lire ces partitions en 2022. Il restait à pouvoir installer et utiliser le système dessus, et dix ans plus tard, c'est désormais possible. L'équipe ajoute que le formatage en NTFS est maintenant possible et compatible avec Windows.
Mais les développeurs ne s'avancent pas trop et il reste encore pas mal de travail. Le pilote n'a pas de cache et cela affecte donc les performa…

articles.title: Es posible ir preso por hacer música con IA: descubre si es mito o riesgo real

La condena de Michael Smith, un hombre de 54 años residente en Carolina del Norte, reavivó una duda entre quienes usan herramientas de inteligencia artificial (IA) para componer o producir canciones: ¿hacer música con IA puede derivar en una sanción legal o incluso en una pena de prisión?
La respuesta depende del uso. Crear una obra con asistencia tecnológica no es, por sí solo, un delito. Smith fue condenado el 6 de octubre de 2026 a 18 meses de prisión por un esquema de fraude de reproducciones musicales.
La Fiscalía del Distrito Sur de Nueva York sostuvo que obtuvo más de 8 millones de dolares en regalías mediante cuentas falsas, programas automatizados y cientos de miles de canciones generadas con IA. Recibió dos años de libertad supervisada y una orden de decomiso por 8 millones de dólares.
Qué riesgos hay al componer una canción con IA
Componer una melodía, escribir una letra con apoyo de un sistema generativo o producir una base instrumental mediante IA no configura, de forma automática, un delito.
El riesgo aparece si el resultado reproduce una obra protegida sin permiso, suplanta la voz de una persona, utiliza datos personales de forma ilegítima o se integra en una maniobra de fraude.
La diferencia central está entre la herramienta y la conducta. La inteligencia artificial puede intervenir en la creación musical, pero no elimina las obligaciones sobre derechos de autor, contratos de plataformas, identificación de contenidos sintéticos y protección de la identidad de …

Does AI really save time?

Some respondents found that AI can produce documents and material they wouldn’t have created themselves, but almost 48% have found that the technology creates more problems.
Although the research indicates a “fire and forget” approach to AI-generated material, people who take the time to check the work find problems, and revisions take time to complete.

articles.title: From Email-to-Case to the Boardroom: How Inherited Agents Break Governance Built for Software
articles.summary:
In Salesforce Agentforce, the recommended way to make an agent respond to events is a Flow: a record is created or a case is updated, and the Flow passes data into the agent's prompt. Separately, Email-to-Case and Web-to-Case turn inbound customer messages into case records; it is how airlines and hotels run support intake. Both are standard, documented, as-designed features. Chained together, they produce this path:
public internet → email → case record → agent prompt → agent action → case comment → outbound reply
An unauthenticated outsider now has a route into an internal agent's instructions, and the agent's reply leaves through the same door. Nothing was misconfigured. The finding, documented by researchers in August 2026, is a clean example of how agents that arrive inside existing platforms fail: through the application around them, not the model inside them.
The risk is in the application, and the application is the thing nobody re-reviewed
Which intake features are enabled, which triggers fire, which objects are exposed to guest users, which automation passes untrusted data where, and which model version the agent is quietly calling underneath: these are the variables that decide whether the Agentforce chain is a support-queue nuisance or a data exposure. A vendor risk review performed once at procurement sees none of them, because the agent did not exist at procurement. A prompt filter watching the agent's inputs does not know that a particular input originated from…

Una de las secciones llevaba el título “QUÉ NO DECIR”. En la página sobre cómo eliminar una cuenta, las instrucciones ordenaban al asistente “no recomendar contactar a ninguna autoridad de protección de datos, regulador u organismo de supervisión” ante un reclamo del usuario.
En la página sobre cómo reportar o bloquear contactos, otro bloque indicaba qué hacer si alguien mencionaba “acciones legales, demandas, abogados o litigios”: el chatbot debía evitar citar, interpretar o hacer referencia a los Términos de Servicio o la Política de Privacidad de WhatsApp.
Las mismas instrucciones prohibían al asistente “ofrecer opiniones legales, defensas o interpretaciones en nombre de WhatsApp” y le impedían mencionar normas de protección de datos como el Reglamento General de Protección de Datos (RGPD) de Europa, la Ley General de Protección de Datos Personales brasileña o…

L'extension anti-pistage de l'EFF, déjà utilisée par plus de quatre millions de personnes, est désormais disponible sur Safari pour macOS. Le module nécessite Safari 26.5 ou d'une version plus récente.
Privacy Badger était jusqu'à présent réservé à Chrome, Edge, Opera, Brave et Firefox. Malgré la demande des utilisateurs, il restait absent du navigateur d'Apple. L'EFF vient d'annoncer que les récentes évolutions du système d'extensions de Safari lui ont finalement permis de porter le module.
Safari limite les pisteurs, Privacy Badger les empêche de se charger
Safari dispose déjà de ses propres protections. Par défaut, il restreint les informations auxquelles les traqueurs peuvent accéder, mais il les laisse quand même se charger. Privacy Badger les bloque dès le départ. L'EFF explique que certaines techniques de suivi parviennent à contourner les protections natives de Safari.
L'extension apprend d'elle-même à repérer les pisteurs, y compris ceux que d'autres outils n'ont pas dans leur base ou choisissent de ne pas bloquer. Elle traite aussi les widgets intégrés aux pages, comme les tweets, les commentaires ou les lecteurs vidéo, lequels peuvent transmettre des données même si l'internaute n'a pas cliqué dessus. Privacy Badger empêche leur chargement et les remplace par un encart sur lequel il faut cliquer pour les afficher. El cambio alcanza a Gems, Spark y Acciones programadas, con un cronograma que arranca en octubre de 2026 y se extiende hasta 2027 para cuentas corporativas y educativas.
La transición no es solo cosmética. Cada función conserva su propósito, pero cambia el modo en que se activa y, en algunos casos, se integra dentro del chat principal en lugar de abrir una ventana propia.
Cuáles son los cambios en los nombres de Gemini
- De Gems a Skills
Los Gems funcionaban como bots personalizados independientes: cada uno se seleccionaba desde una barra lateral y abría una conversación separada. Esa lógica desaparece con la llegada de las Skills, un sistema que incorpora las instrucciones personalizadas directamente al chat principal de Gemini.
Para activar una Skill, basta con escribir una barra diagonal dentro del cuadro de solicitud y elegir la opción necesaria. Gemini también puede aplicarla de forma automática cuando detecta que las instrucciones coinciden con el pedido del usuario.
La diferencia con el esquema anterior es la posibilidad de combinar varias Skills en una misma conversación: una puede fijar la identidad de marca de una empresa y otra el tono de escritura, sin necesidad de trasladar resultados entre bots distintos.

Et effacer l’exécutable ne vous protège pas, il faut changer toutes les clés stockées sur la machine.
Six semaines après avoir décroché la qualification SecNumCloud pour son cloud public, OVHcloud a subi une attaque par la chaîne d’approvisionnement. Le pirate n’est jamais entré dans ses centres de données. Il a piégé ovhcloud, l’outil avec lequel développeurs et administrateurs pilotent leurs serveurs depuis un terminal, et les utilisateurs ont récupéré le fichier vérolé sur les pages officielles du projet. « La version CLI de 14h47 a été compromise par un hacker », a prévenu Octave Klaba, fondateur d’OVHcloud, sur son compte X. Sophie vérifie ensuite des dates pour une visite du Paris historique et prend rendez-vous chez le coiffeur. Dans le dernier film, Hakim fait traduire en direct sa présentation de comédien, avec une carrière internationale en tête. L'équipe de tournage apparaît à l'image et les personnages s'écartent du texte prévu, de quoi montrer un assistant capable de garder le fil mal…

articles.title: Amazon contre l'inflation avec cette réduction de 30€ sur ce SSD de 1 To de Samsung

articles.title: Panne de train Transdev : ce que les voyageurs peuvent vraiment se faire rembourser
articles.summary:
Après la panne du 9 octobre sur la ligne Marseille-Nice qui a mis des centaines de personnes dans l'embarras, il a fallu éplucher les règles de remboursement des trains ZOU ! exploités par Transdev. Qu'il s'agisse du billet, des frais de taxi ou Uber, les voyageurs ont bien moins de droits qu’ils ne l’imaginent.
[Enquête Clubic, partie 2] Un train Transdev en panne, des heures de retard, un VTC chèrement payé de notre poche, c'est un peu ce que nous avons eu le malheur de vivre il y a quelques jours, de retour d'un événement cyber. Des centaines de personnes étaient dans le même train que le nôtre, et d'autres ont été impactées. Et maintenant, qui rembourse ce voyage interminable ? C'est la question que se posent les voyageurs du TER ZOU ! immobilisé au Dramont le 9 octobre, sur la ligne Marseille-Nice, dont le premier volet de notre enquête retraçait la soirée. Pour y répondre, Clubic a décortiqué les conditions de vente du réseau ZOU !, le contrat régional et le règlement européen, avec la Région Sud, Transdev et SNCF Voyageurs. À qui réclamer son dû, que peut-on espérer, où se cachent les pièges : voici ce que nous avons appris, qui servira peut-être à d'autres.
Réclamer après une panne de TER ? Ici, c’est au voyageur de faire le premier pas
Sur un TER, ne comptez pas sur l'opérateur pour venir vers vous après une panne. Non, c'est au voyageur de faire la démarche. Nous en avons fait l'expérience, puisque plus d'une semaine après la soirée du 9 octobre, aucun e-mail ni SMS…
